label: Status morph (one black shape through states)
description: ONE black pill that keeps changing shape through a list of states -- the order-button morph as a reusable piece: a label (e.g. 'Order print', or a check + 'Ordered'), a spinner, a progress state (printer icon, 'Printing', a percentage counting 0->100 with a thin line), a route state ('On its way' / 'today' with a tiny van driving a dotted route to a house), and a done circle whose check draws itself. Labels rise out of the shape's own mask while the shape resizes; nothing fades. A built-in cursor clicks the pill as the first morph starts. The pill sits at `pill` (centre x/y, width, height as fractions of the box); the done circle defaults to the done handoff geometry (centre 0.5/0.62, diameter 0.12). If the first state is a label at `at`, it is the pill's standing face. States' `at`/`to` are scene seconds. Example: {"at":0.2,"pill":{"x":0.5,"y":0.62,"w":0.44,"h":0.075},"states":[{"kind":"label","text":"Order print","at":0.2},{"kind":"spinner","at":0.3},{"kind":"label","icon":"check","text":"Ordered","at":0.65},{"kind":"progress","icon":"printer","text":"Printing","at":1.05,"to":1.85},{"kind":"route","text":"On its way","right":"today","at":2.15,"to":2.65},{"kind":"done","at":2.9}]}.

at.label: Scene second it starts (default 0); default states are relative to it

pill.label: The pill: centre x/y, width w (of the box width), height h (of the box height). Default {x:0.5,y:0.62,w:0.44,h:0.075}

done.label: The done circle: centre x/y and size (diameter, fraction of the box's short side). Default the pill's centre, 0.12

states.label: In order (scene seconds). Default: Order print -> spinner -> Ordered -> Printing % -> On its way -> done

to.label: progress/route: when the bar or the van arrives

w.label: Width multiplier of the pill for this state

h.label: Height multiplier of the pill for this state

appear.label: none (standing from the start, default) | pop (springs from zero at appear_at)

font_scale.label: Type size as a fraction of the pill height (default 0.3)

click_at.label: When the cursor clicks the pill (default: the first morph - 0.05)

cursor_from.label: Cursor start [x, y], fractions of the box (default [0.74, 0.82])
